claims.statement: The repository portfolio specifies one upstream Maintainer and separate content research and publication roles; its desired configuration does not prove live scheduler registration or execution.
The portfolio defines three native automation roles and gives the upstream Maintainer an explicit PAUSED status with worktree execution.
Upstream maintenance must tie necessary adaptations to existing consumers and wait for a user decision before implementing new optional features.

The daily maintenance prompt limits automatic implementation to retained capabilities, requires user selection for new features and uses an approximate 30-minute active-work boundary with durable continuation.

The maintenance prompt follows a fixed latest-main commit, requires matching runtime artifact qualification and source, test and consumer review for each commit, and forbids advancing the contiguous cursor past unread or unresolved review evidence.
Manual catch-up keeps the automation paused; completion or a configuration change does not authorize resumption without an explicit user instruction.
